description: This file defines the MainWearActivity class for an Android Wear application. It manages runtime permissions (specifically BODY_SENSORS), communicates with a paired phone via Google Play Services (Data Layer API), handles capability detection for the phone, and provides UI elements for requesting permissions and displaying data. It also includes logic for permission requests, capability updates, and messaging between devices.

classes.name: MainWearActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the wearable device, handling permissions, device capability detection, messaging, and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and connects to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onClickWearBodySensors
methods.description: Handles UI click to request or display local sensor info.

methods.name: onClickPhoneStorage
methods.description: Requests data from the paired phone.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reconnects to GoogleApiClient and checks permission status.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intent to prompt permission dialog from phone.

methods.name: onEnterAmbient
methods.description: Handles ambient mode entry, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onExitAmbient
methods.description: Handles ambient mode exit, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback for successful connection to GoogleApiClient, sets up capability and message listeners.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for suspended GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback for failed GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Handles updates in device capability for the paired phone.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user's response to permission requests, updates UI and sends messages accordingly.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from the phone, updates UI, and handles permission-based communication.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the paired phone via the Wearable MessageApi.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission prompts initiated for the phone.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the best node ID from a set of nodes, prioritizing nearby nodes.

methods.name: launchPermissionDialogForPhone
methods.description: Starts permission request activity on the wear device.

methods.name: updatePhoneButtonOnUiThread
methods.description: Updates the UI button state for phone storage permission status.

methods.name: logToUi
methods.description: Logs messages to the UI and debug log, ensuring thread safety.
